description: This file contains a PHP unit test class `MenuServiceTest` which tests the `MenuService` component of the OrangeHRM system. It sets up various test scenarios to verify menu item generation for different user roles, mocks dependencies, and verifies the structured menu output.

classes.name: MenuServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the MenuService, especially its menu item retrieval functions based on user roles and current request context.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Class-level setup to populate test data fixtures and truncate specific tables.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test, initializing MenuService and disabling I18N.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Restores the I18N configuration after each test.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsForAdmin
methods.description: Tests menu item retrieval for an Admin user, verifying correct menu structure.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsForSupervisor
methods.description: Tests menu item retrieval for a Supervisor user, verifying correct menu structure.
